title: Engineer III (SAP SD)
jobDescription: As an SAP SD (Order-to-Cash) Senior Application Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting SAP S/4HANA SD solutions. You will work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions across the O2C lifecycle, while contributing to continuous improvements and digital transformation initiatives. requirements Work on SAP S/4HANA SD / Simple Logistics implementations, enhancements, and support engagements Perform ABAP debugging , analyze technical issues, and collaborate with developers for code fixes or enhancements Prepare functional specifications (FS), support technical design (TS), and validate developments Partner with cross-functional teams (FI, PP, QM, PM) to ensure seamless integration Configure and optimize key SD components such as: Sales order processing, delivery, billing Pricing, output determination, and tax configuration Credit management and revenue recognition integration Support EDI/IDOC integrations , interfaces, and message processing Identify system improvement opportunities and drive optimization initiatives Participate in unit testing, SIT, UAT, and production support activities Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with strong analytical skills Ensure adherence to development standards, documentation, and best practices What you'll need 6+ years of hands-on experience in SAP SD , with strong focus on O2C processes At least 1 full-cycle SAP implementation , preferably on SAP S/4HANA SD / Simple Logistics Deep understanding of Order-to-Cash processes , including: Sales order management Pricing (advanced pricing concepts, condition techniques) Billing and invoicing Shipping and delivery processes Strong configuration expertise in: Enterprise structure Master data (customer, material, pricing conditions) Output determination, taxes, and billing processes Good understanding of integration with FI (accounts receivable), COPA, and logistics execution Experience in IDOC processing, EDI integration , and interface troubleshooting Hands-on experience with: User exits, BADIs, enhancements Functional specifications for RICEFW objects ABAP debugging skills (mandatory) and ability to analyze code behavior Exposure to basic ABAP development (reports, enhancements, forms) is highly desirable Strong experience in support, upgrade, and enhancement projects Nice to Have Experience with ABAP on HANA / CDS views / debugging in S/4 environment Exposure to Fiori apps in SD Knowledge of advanced ATP (a ATP), FSCM Credit Management Experience working in global template rollouts or multi-country implementations We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
